'''TeeDeeEl'''<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was an [[XL-Lioness]] [[TDL nanny droid]]<ref name="EGTD" /> in service to the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]]. TeeDeeEl was responsible for looking after the infant [[Anakin Solo]] at [[Anoth Base]]. When Anoth Base was [[Battle of Anoth (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] in an effort to capture Anakin Solo, TeeDeeEl attempted to protect her charge. She managed to kill a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], but was destroyed in turn by Ambassador Furgan's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="CotF" />
